ERR_ROUTER_QUEUE_FULL.message: The board is busy: a command from {src} was dropped

ERR_ROUTER_FRAME_LEN.message: A command of {len} bytes from {src} was refused (at most {max})

ERR_ROUTER_BUSY.message: Urgent work could not start: other urgent work waits to run

ERR_ROUTER_CALLS_FULL.message: Too many requests to other boards at once

ERR_ROUTER_NO_LINK.message: Connection {port} cannot be reached from here
ERR_ROUTER_NO_LINK.hint: Link the router with it in the data matrix.

ERR_ROUTER_CALL_TIMEOUT.hint: A write may still have run: read the value back.

ERR_ROUTER_CALL_DOWN.message: Connection {port} was lost before its answer came
